title: Smoke alarms in a Queensland rental
description: Smoke alarm checks for a leased Queensland dwelling. Summarised from Queensland Fire Department and RTA pages.

items.title: Photoelectric alarms to AS 3786-2014, with no ionisation alarms
All required alarms interconnected so they sound together
Hardwired, or powered by a non-removable 10-year battery
Each alarm less than 10 years past its manufacture date
An alarm in every bedroom, in hallways connecting bedrooms and on every storey
Test and clean the alarms within 30 days before each tenancy starts or is renewed
Replace flat or nearly flat batteries within 30 days before each tenancy starts or is renewed
Give the tenant the manufacturer's instructions
Give 48 hours' notice to enter for smoke alarm work
